definitions.gloss: to pulsate; to throb; to beat
definitions.explanation: To beat or throb rhythmically, as a pulse or heartbeat. Refers to the rhythmic movement of blood through arteries.

definitions.gloss: to pulse with life; to be alive with energy
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to be vibrant and full of life or energy. Used for cities, cultures, or anything that feels dynamically alive.

examples.japanese: こめかみが{脈打|みゃくう}っている。
{激|はげ}しい{運動|うんどう}の{後|あと}、{首筋|くびすじ}に{脈打|みゃくう}つ{血管|けっかん}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: After intense exercise, I could see the blood vessels pulsating in my neck.

examples.japanese: {心臓|しんぞう}が{力強|ちからづよ}く{脈打|みゃくう}つのを{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: I felt my heart beating strongly.

examples.japanese: {街|まち}には{活気|かっき}が{脈打|みゃくう}っている。
examples.english: The city is pulsing with energy.

examples.japanese: この{音楽|おんがく}には{命|いのち}が{脈打|みゃくう}っている。
{古|ふる}い{町並|まちな}みの{中|なか}に、{伝統|でんとう}が{今|いま}も{脈打|みゃくう}っているのを{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: Among the old townscape, you can feel that tradition is still alive and pulsing.

notes:
USAGE:
{脈打|みゃくう}つ is a godan verb combining {脈|みゃく} (pulse) and {打|う}つ (to strike). It is intransitive.

ASPECT (ている):
{脈打|みゃくう}っている describes an ongoing, rhythmic pulsation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心臓|しんぞう}が{脈打|みゃくう}つ (the heart beats)
- こめかみが{脈打|みゃくう}つ (temples throb)
- {命|いのち}が{脈打|みゃくう}つ (life pulses)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{鼓動|こどう}する means to beat (of the heart) and focuses specifically on the heartbeat. {脈打|みゃくう}つ is broader and can describe any pulsating movement, including figurative uses.
